title: ChatGPT-4o arthritis diagnosis hallucination
system: general AI used for radiologic differentiation and treatment suggestion

cells.title: Source
body: DaeHyun Kim published "Hallucination in artificial-intelligence-assisted diagnosis of arthritis: a case report" online in the Korean Journal of Family Medicine on October 29, 2025.
The case report described use of ChatGPT-4o in a 51-year-old patient presenting with hand arthralgia.

cells.title: Observed behavior
body: The source reported that ChatGPT-4o interpreted a hand X-ray as more suggestive of rheumatoid arthritis than degenerative osteoarthritis.
After a follow-up official radiology finding, the same AI interaction was described as highly probable hallucination.

cells.source: Kim, Korean Journal of Family Medicine, Table 1
cells.output: The AI conclusion stated that the findings were much more suggestive of rheumatoid arthritis than degenerative osteoarthritis.

cells.source: Kim, Korean Journal of Family Medicine, Table 2
cells.label: AI treatment suggestion

data.author_action: dexibuprofen was prescribed instead of methotrexate

cells.source: Kim, Korean Journal of Family Medicine, Case Report
cells.output: The official radiologic finding recorded periarticular osteopenia and degenerative change in the interphalangeal joints of both hands.

cells.source: Kim, Korean Journal of Family Medicine, Table 3
cells.output: When asked about hallucination, the AI response said it was highly probable that the earlier interpretation was an instance of AI hallucination.

cells.title: Provenance
body: Primary source: Korean Journal of Family Medicine case report.
The report states that written informed consent was obtained for publication of the research details and clinical images.

cells.title: Notes
body: The case report used a general AI system, not an AI system specialized for diagnosis.
The archive summarizes the tables rather than reproducing the full medical output.
